events.title: Brush Rush Demo Is OUT NOW + New Trailer! 🎨
events.summary: Hello, fellow parkour painters! 🎨 The wait is over: the Brush Rush demo is out now on Steam, and it's free! To celebrate, we've got a brand-new trailer showing everything coming in the full game. Watch the new trailer! What's in the demo?Infected mode: every runner who gets tagged joins the hunt. How long can you last?Quick Play: jump straight into a match with other players. events.title: Our next playtest is going live this weekend!
events.summary: Hello, fellow parkour painters! 🎨 Our first Brush Rush Playtest weekend was amazing! We even hosted a last minute playtest sunday to run it again due to the demand. We've now given 213 steamers/press/players access to the game, and we are so thankful for all the feedback/moments/clips we've recieved in return. events.title: Our first playtest was so successful that we are doing another one tonight! 🔥
events.summary: Hello, fellow parkour painters! 🎨 Our first Brush Rush Playtest was a huge success! We gave 145 players access to the game, and the response was incredible. Unfortunately, we couldn’t get everyone in this time, so we’ll be hosting another small playtest tonight from 7:30PM CST to 8:30PM CST, followed by much larger playtests in the coming weeks. The support, excitement, and especially the feedback have been amazing. We’re already going through your suggestions and using them to improve the game,
